publication. The final VRT payable may change depending on vehicle specification. Please confirm final pricing and taxes with your authorised Volkswagen retailer. 
(2) Fuel consumption, CO₂ emissions and electric range figures shown are official WLTP values for standard production vehicles. Optional equipment and accessories may affect these values. Real world performance will vary depending on driving style, speed, weather, passengers, load and use of vehicle systems. For exact vehicle values, please 
configure your vehicle at volkswagen.ie. 
(3) Govt (Government) incentives refer to VRT relief and applicable SEAI Grant for Private Customers, Business/Commercial Buyer State subsidy comprises of VRT relief, all of which are subject to approval. SEAI Grant is not applicable on vehicles with a list price of over €50,000 from August 1st 2026.
